description.description: One or two sentences under the heading. Pass an empty string to hide it.

visual.description: Which built-in illustration to draw: a live doc, a command menu, a bar chart, an automation, role switches, or a version scrubber.

size.description: On wide screens: wide spans two thirds, tall spans two rows, half spans half a row, regular a third.

href.description: Makes the title a link that covers the whole cell.

features.description: The cells, in reading order. Six read best. Each has id, title, description, visual, and optional size and href.

visuals.description: Replaces an illustration by feature id, for your own screenshot or component.
